Reply here if you need a hand.

records.text: New signup alert -- *North Works* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: No customer replies to three outreach emails, no project at day 6 (stall_reasons: no_key_milestone, no_first_project). But one invite sent and the welcome call was held as scheduled [calendar:0b6f724f], an active Pro subscription, and 8 days left — decent but unproven momentum.

draft.subject: Following up on our welcome call
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Thanks for making time yesterday — good to talk through what North Works wants to run in Wrenfield. Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, getting the first one going is usually the step that makes everything else click, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and set that first project up with you — just reply with a time that suits and I'll work around it.

Best,
Chidi
